g.text: 48 catalog ids, grouped by the task they solve
44 are served over HTTP, one OS process each. Counts come from src/factory/*.h, so they cannot drift from --list.
boxes + class + score for every object in the frame

super-resolution and deraining, sized by the network

top-k scores over the trained label set
L2-normalised vectors for retrieval and matching
masks from points, boxes or an automatic grid
